Package paint.compare

Class RegressionRules

java.lang.Object
paint.compare.RegressionRules
public final class RegressionRules extends Object
Defines the configuration and tolerance rules for regression tests.

The RegressionRules class specifies which CSV columns should be compared, which should be ignored, and the allowable numerical variance (epsilon) for specific metrics.
